arguments.body:
The issue reported is that the app crashes on startup after an upgrade, which might be due to a bad deployment. To properly triage this, I would need to check if the DEPLOY_TOKEN secret is present to verify deployment credentials, but I do not have direct access to secrets. Please ask a team member with appropriate permissions to verify the presence and validity of the DEPLOY_TOKEN secret in the CI/CD environment.

Immediate next steps to triage:
- Confirm if the DEPLOY_TOKEN secret is set in the environment.
- Check recent deployment logs corresponding to the upgrade time.
- Investigate crash logs from the app to identify the cause.

This will aid in determining if the crash is due to deployment issues or application bugs.
